tableOfContents.text: What is a QR Code for Payments?
How QR Code Collections Help Your Business

inlineImageAndParagraph.text: A QR code for payments is a scannable code that lets customers make instant digital payments using any UPI-enabled app. Instead of entering bank details or handling cash, users simply scan the QR code, confirm the amount, and complete the payment.

inlineImageAndParagraph2.text: QR codes have become the preferred payment method across India because they are fast and contactless, compatible with all major UPI apps, and easy to deploy across online and offline use cases. For businesses, QR codes eliminate hardware dependency while offering real-time payment visibility and reconciliation.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.query: What is a QR code generator?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: A QR code generator creates scannable codes that customers can use to initiate UPI payments securely and instantly.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.query: Is there any hardware required to accept QR payments?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: No. QR codes eliminate the need for POS machines or card terminals, reducing operational costs and complexity.
